title: Run result v1
description: One status per cell of the plan.v1 the run was given (plan_digest). A planned cell absent here is not_run; dokimi.runner.plan.completeness computes planned minus completed and refuses to call a run complete while any planned cell lacks a measured status (pass, fail or inconclusive).

execution_id.description: the run's execution id, when the producer has one

model.description: the model that answered (resolved), which may differ from the planned id
